rules.description: [Debug]: Caps+1 -> Show app and modifiers
[Layer]: [Caps] to [Caps Primary Layer]
[Map][RDP]: [Caps] to [F1]
[Layer][RDP]: [F1] to [Caps Primary Layer]
[Layer][Non-RDP]: Caps+[LOpt/RCmd/LCmd] -> [Caps Secondary Layer]
[Map]: [Fn] to [Cmd], or to [Ctrl] in RDP
[Map]: [BuiltInKbd] [LCtrl] to [Fn] for built-in keyboard
[Map]: [ExternalKbd] [LCtrl] to [no remap] in RDP, or to [LCmd] otherwise
[Map]: [LOpt] <-> [LCmd] in RDP; [LCmd] to [LCtrl] otherwise
[Map]: [RCmd] to [ROpt]
[Map]: [BuiltInKbd/LogiMechanical] [ROpt] to [RCtrl] in RDP, or to [RCmd] otherwise
[Map]: [ExternalKbd] [RCtrl] to [no remap] in RDP, or to [RCmd] otherwise
[Map][Optional]: [F2] -> [Middle mouse button] (turned off by default)
Caps+Space -> insert a full-width space
Caps+B -> Fn
Caps+Z -> Type Clipboard, Caps+Shift+Z -> Repair Clipboard Images
Caps+A -> Toggle Caps Lock, Caps+Q -> Esc, except Anki
Caps+Backslash/Pipe -> ISO Non-US Backslash/Pipe
Caps+Backspace -> Delete first character of previous two-character word, Caps+Shift+Backspace -> Delete current line

to.shell_command: /opt/miniconda3/bin/python3 -S ${HOME}/.config/karabiner/scripts/send_keys.py --release-key delete_or_backspace --key command+right_arrow --key command+shift+left_arrow --key command+shift+left_arrow --key command+delete_or_backspace --key command+delete_or_backspace

rules.description: Caps+Grave -> Release Modifiers and Disable Caps Lock, Caps+4/6/7 -> Selected Text Tools
[Caps Secondary Layer]: Tab -> Literal Tab, (Shift)+T -> Setter/Getter
Caps+(Shift)+Tab -> Indent/Unindent Selected Lines
Caps+(Shift)+Semicolon -> Insert semicolon/colon at end of line
Caps+Quote -> Insert colon at end of line
[Caps Secondary Layer]: C/V/X, Shift+C/X for Current Line, Shift+V Advanced Paste, Z Type Clipboard
Caps+V -> Paste as Plain Text, Caps+Shift+V -> Advanced Paste
Caps+X -> Cut, Caps+Shift+X -> Cut this line

to.shell_command: /opt/miniconda3/bin/python3 -S ${HOME}/.config/karabiner/scripts/send_keys.py --release-key x --key command+right_arrow --key command+shift+left_arrow --key command+shift+left_arrow --key command+x --key command+right_arrow --key delete_or_backspace

rules.description: Caps+C -> Copy, Caps+Shift+C -> Copy this line

to.shell_command: /opt/miniconda3/bin/python3 -S ${HOME}/.config/karabiner/scripts/send_keys.py --release-key c --key command+right_arrow --key command+shift+left_arrow --key command+shift+left_arrow --key command+c --key command+right_arrow

rules.description: Caps+U/O -> Mouse Click
Caps+P -> Toggle Built-in Screen (while external monitors connected to a MacBook)
Caps+Enter -> End of line + newline, Caps+Shift+Enter -> Insert line above
Caps+I/J/K/L -> Move Mouse Pointer
Caps+Shift+-/= -> Horizontal Scroll, Caps+-/= -> Trackpad Pinch Zoom
Caps+E -> Quick access menu, except Anki
Caps+W -> Show frontmost window information, except Anki
Caps+R -> Fit and center window, Caps+Shift+R -> Resize to 1024x768 and center, except Anki
[Cherry Studio]: Cmd+Return -> Ctrl+Return
[Rime]: Caps+Period -> Toggle Punct Mode
[Anki]: Caps+Q/W/E/R/T/A/S/D/F/G -> Custom Shortcuts
